title: GEEK BAR PULSE TOBACCO
description:
GEEK BAR PULSE TOBACCO
Experience the authentic flavor of tobacco with the
Geek Bar Pulse Tobacco
. The dual mesh coil design allows for a consistent and smooth hit with each pull of vapor. The device features a
full-screen display
, and has a
rechargeable battery of 650mAh
that allows you to choose between Regular or Pulse mode.
This product is built for lasting enjoyment, providing up to 15,000 puffs and has straight forward draw-activation. The rechargeable battery provides the opportunity to get
15,000 puffs in Regular Mode
and
7,500 in Pulse Mode
. The battery and
16ml e-liquid
indicated on the attractive full-screen display turn into real-time notifications with every puff. The
dual mesh coil
and intuitive
draw activation
makes for smooth and tasty hits.
Place your order for the
Geek Bar Pulse Tobacco
with us today for the ultimate experience of harmony from flavor to performance and convenience with each puff.
